scheme_name: PM-YASASVI: Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
description:
The PM-YASASVI scheme is a significant initiative launched by the Government of India to provide financial assistance to students from Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and Denotified Tribes (DNT). 

The scheme was officially launched on September 27, 2021. 

The primary objective of PM-YASASVI is to promote education among students belonging to these marginalized communities. 

The scheme aims to provide financial support to students pursuing pre-matric education. 

The financial assistance is intended to alleviate the economic burden on families and encourage students to continue their education without financial constraints. 

The scheme specifically targets students studying in classes 9 and 10. 

Under PM-YASASVI, the scholarship amount is set at ₹75,000 per annum for students enrolled in classes 9 and 10. 

This amount is intended to cover various educational expenses including tuition fees, books, and other necessary materials. 

The scholarship is disbursed directly to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries to ensure transparency and efficiency. 

To be eligible for the PM-YASASVI scholarship, students must belong to the OBC, EBC, or DNT categories. 

The annual family income limit for eligibility is set at ₹2.5 lakh. 

Students must be enrolled in recognized schools that are affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) or any state board. 

Additionally, students must have secured at least 50% marks in their previous examination to qualify for the scholarship. 

The application process for PM-YASASVI is conducted online through the official website. 

Students need to register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) to apply for the scholarship. 

The required documents for application include a caste certificate, income certificate, and previous academic records. 

Students must also provide their bank account details for the disbursement of the scholarship amount. 

The application window for PM-YASASVI typically opens in the month of August each year. 

The last date for submission of applications is usually in September. 

Once the applications are submitted, they are reviewed by the implementing authorities. 

The scholarship amount is generally disbursed within a few months after the application deadline. 

The Ministry of Education is the primary implementing authority for the PM-YASASVI scheme. 

The National Testing Agency (NTA) is responsible for conducting the entrance examination for the scholarship. 

The entrance examination is usually held in the month of October. 

Students who qualify in the entrance examination are then eligible to receive the scholarship. 

The examination consists of multiple-choice questions covering subjects such as Mathematics, Science, and Social Studies. 

The scholarship is awarded based on the merit of the students in the entrance examination. 

The PM-YASASVI scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Government of India to enhance educational opportunities for marginalized communities. 

The scheme is designed to reduce dropout rates among OBC, EBC, and DNT students. 

The government aims to increase the enrollment of students from these communities in secondary education. 

The scheme also seeks to promote higher education among these students in the long term. 

The scholarship is expected to benefit thousands of students across the country. 

In the first year of implementation, the government allocated ₹300 crores for the PM-YASASVI scheme. 

This funding is intended to support the scholarship disbursement and administrative costs associated with the scheme. 

The government has set a target to increase the number of beneficiaries each year. 

The PM-YASASVI scheme is expected to play a crucial role in achieving the goal of universal education in India. 

The government also aims to create awareness about the scheme among eligible students and their families. 

Workshops and outreach programs are being organized to inform communities about the benefits of the PM-YASASVI scholarship. 

The scheme is aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) set by the United Nations, particularly Goal 4, which focuses on quality education. 

The PM-YASASVI scheme is an important step towards achieving educational equity in India. 

The government is committed to ensuring that students from OBC, EBC, and DNT backgrounds have access to quality education. 

The scheme is expected to empower these students and help them build a better future. 

Monitoring and evaluation mechanisms are in place to assess the impact of the PM-YASASVI scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the implementation of the scheme. 

The government is also exploring partnerships with non-governmental organizations (NGOs) to enhance the reach of the scheme. 

The PM-YASASVI scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to social justice and educational empowerment. 

The scheme is expected to contribute significantly to the overall development of marginalized communities in India. 

In conclusion, the PM-YASASVI scheme represents a vital initiative aimed at fostering educational opportunities for OBC, EBC, and DNT students. 

With a structured approach to financial assistance and support, the scheme is poised to make a lasting impact on the educational landscape in India. 

The government continues to work towards refining and expanding the scheme to ensure that it meets the needs of its beneficiaries effectively. 

Students and families are encouraged to take advantage of this opportunity to secure their educational futures. 

The PM-YASASVI scheme stands as a beacon of hope for many aspiring students across the nation.
